text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of every racer's<n>career are
incredibly important. During<n>those years, Rice
Shower has<n>achieved some incredible feats.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: People all over have praised her<n>efforts.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...An a-award ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You did help make the<n>Takarazuka
Kinen happen, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So many people in the URA want to<n>celebrate you
by holding a ceremony<n>in your honor.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm happy to hear it, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By all means, please grace them with<n>your
presence.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The staff from the Hanshin and Kyoto<n>Racecourses
are looking forward to<n>seeing you there as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... They're the ones who did<n>everything in their
power when I<n>asked for help.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right. I have to thank them in<n>person.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Rice Shower and I visit<n>the Hanshin
Racecourse together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-there are so many people... And<n>it's not even a
raceday…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow, look, it's Rice! Oooh, she's so<n>cute!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Rice! It's so great to see you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What?!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, you two!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-it's nice to see you again! But, um...<n>what's going
on?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Oh this? Well, the original plan was<n>just a
celebration with the staff, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Rice! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there were lots of<n>fans that also
wanted to see you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! L-love?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. So we changed our<n>plans and pulled a
few strings.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
As a result, the award ceremony is<n>now open to the
general public.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see... Then all these people... came<n>to see me?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
That's right... By the way, may we<n>ask you to do
what you weren't able<n>to do last time?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Here, in front of all the people excited<n>to see you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uh, um... Hi, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm Ri—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Screeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-haha... sorry. The mic is kind of...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I hope I didn't hurt your<n>ears.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! We're okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you. Ummm, well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I would like to thank everyone for<n>coming here to
see me today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen anything like this<n>before, and... I'm
so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, so happy... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Don't cry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-right! Sorry... I won't cry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because today, I want to be able to<n>look you all in
the eye while I talk to<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I used to be really lonely. I was<n>stuck cowering in
a dark place,<n>always hiding away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I'm not alone anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's because of all of you that I'm<n>able to stand
here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You brought me light, and gave me a<n>place to
belong to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, from the bottom of my<n>heart!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
We'll now move on to presenting the<n>certificate of
our gratitude as well as<n>the award. Please turn your
attention<n>to the screen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hi, everyone! Hi, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Greetings.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come on, Bourbon! Don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have analyzed the script thoroughly.<n>You are the
only one who is<n>supposed to speak.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's fiiine! Don't worry about the<n>script!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Anyway, there's tons of Rice fans<n>over here too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Data indicates plans for a<n>commemorative plaque
are currently<n>underway as well.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! Don't ruin the surprise,<n>Bourbon! Shhh!
Shhh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Broadcast time has elapsed. Back to<n>you, Hanshin.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What, time's up?! Bye-bye, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I'm sorry... I said that I<n>wouldn't cry, but...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Miss Rice, do you have anything<n>you'd like to add?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Pessoal... A Rice vai continuar dando<n>tudo de si,
então...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Por favor... por favor, continuem<n>apoiando a Rice!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On the bus home...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yawn... That was fun... I didn't thinktoday would be so memorable.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Brother. Because of<n>you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister. Because of<n>you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I could...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I was always so useless, but now<n>I've become a
blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the book, I know bad things will<n>still probably
happen sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But this blue rose's wish is to keep<n>blooming and
to bring happiness to<n>everyone, forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Alongside my favorite person in the<n>whole wide
world.
